name: 茜琳·白篙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1251
who: Sirin Whitepole, a tiefling ferry girl of eighteen who poles the lead boat at the Grey River crossing; wiry and quick from forty crossings a day. Coral-red hair in one short braid at the nape. Grey-violet eyes, sharp and watchful, always counting the heads in a boat. A pair of small dark horns at the temples, each about a knuckle long, the tips filed smooth and round by her own hand so they cannot snag a mooring rope. Fair skin, palms rough with pole calluses, cheeks reddened by the river wind. She goes barefoot even in winter. Her white-ash punting pole, longer than two people are tall, never leaves her. A brisk, bossy, steady-footed air, not a meek boat girl. No earrings, no jewellery.
build: 166 cm, slender and wiry: flat, strong shoulders, a C-cup, a tight narrow waist, modest hips and hard, muscular calves.
palette: coral red, steam-bleached leather white, faded flax, grey violet, pale ash-wood white
casual: Her ferry clothes: an old short-sleeved undyed linen shirt; over it a sleeveless leather jerkin bleached almost white by the river steam, laced down the front; flax linen trousers rolled to just below the knee and tied with a cord belt; bare feet. She holds the white-ash punting pole upright beside her, far taller than she is, its butt wrapped in grey fish skin, one hand high on the shaft, the chin up, a brisk no-nonsense look.
private: At the ferry house after the last crossing: a loose long-sleeved faded blue linen shirt, a long rust-brown coarse wool skirt to the ankles, an old sheepskin over her shoulders worn fur inside, still barefoot, the braid untied and the hair loose to the shoulders. She holds a steaming wooden bowl of soup in both hands, a tired, satisfied look.
battle: Holding the crossing: the bleached leather jerkin cinched tight with a broad leather belt, leather bracers over the forearms, the trousers bound at the shins with cloth strips, bare feet planted wide. She holds the long white-ash pole crosswise in both hands like a quarterstaff, the fish-skin-wrapped butt angled forward, the brows drawn together, the mouth set.
formal: The ferry folk's best for a river-blessing day: a clean long-sleeved white linen shirt with a high round collar, a deep grey-violet wool waistcoat that closes down the front with small brass buttons, a long coral-red wool skirt to the ankles with a band of wave-pattern stitching at the hem, a fresh white cord tying the braid, barefoot as always. She stands very straight holding the white-ash pole upright beside her, a small proud closed-mouth smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large, the grey-violet eyes looking sharply back at the viewer over her shoulder as if telling them to grab her pole and not the gunwale. Cool white river-mist light from one side, a warm late-sun rim on the coral braid and the rounded horn tips. Foreground blur: drifting river steam, water drops flicked off the white-ash pole, a frayed mooring rope.

name: 瑟涅·盐汲
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2054
who: Sene Saltdraw, a deep-tide demon woman of the salt lake whose name has set; she was born around year 200 and her face stopped at about twenty-six. Supple in the shoulders and arms. Pale cyan hair in fine small braids lying close along the nape. Warm orange-gold eyes. Smooth grey-blue skin, two thin gill slits behind each ear, a scatter of fine scales just below the collarbones. Both forearms, from the elbows to the fingertips, salt-white ever since the three days she held the salt wall. She always carries a small blue glass bottle. A soft, chatty, sweet-toothed air that turns short and plain when someone has to be stopped. No earrings.
build: 172 cm, lithe and supple: soft but strong shoulders and arms, a D-cup, a slim waist and softly rounded hips.
palette: deep green, pale cyan, salt white, grey blue, orange gold
casual: Her salt-lake working clothes: a sleeveless deep green coarse wool smock to mid-calf, belted with a plaited rush cord, a short open sheepskin vest worn fur inside over it, brine-stained leather sandals wrapped with thongs. She holds a small blue glass bottle in one salt-white hand and a wooden brine bucket by its rope handle in the other, a soft, warm half-smile.
private: At home in the north quarter of the rain city: a long loose undyed linen dress with wide long sleeves pushed up to show the salt-white forearms, a deep green wool shawl, bare feet, the braids loosened. She stands turning a small blue glass bottle against the light and peering into it, a dreamy look.
battle: Holding back the brine: the deep green sleeveless smock belted tight with the hem tucked up into the belt, close-wrapped grey wool leggings, bare feet, the pale cyan braids tied back with a strip of cloth. Both salt-white arms are flung wide, a thin arc of brine rising from her palms and crusting into white salt ribs along her forearms; the orange-gold eyes hard, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and still, the feet planted wide, both salt-white arms spread open as if holding up a wall of water, a thin arc of brine and white salt crystals rising from her palms, the mouth set; she holds no weapon.
formal: For the salt carters' song day: a long deep green wool robe that closes down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves ending at the elbow to bare the salt-white forearms, white salt-knot cords tied around the waist, a necklace of small pale shells, the braids pinned up at the back of the head. She stands with the hands folded in front, the blue bottle hanging from her fingers on a cord, a gentle smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, the orange-gold eyes turned to the viewer with a soft, coaxing look, offering a small blue glass bottle toward them in one salt-white hand. Pale cool lake light from below and one side, a glitter of salt on her lashes and on the gill slits behind her ear. Foreground blur: drifting white salt flakes, the rim of a blue glass bottle, a fine mist of brine.

name: 内森
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2257
who: Nathan, a human machinist of the Ash-Rain gate, a gentle, brilliant self-taught engineer of about twenty-eight, exactly as he looks in the design references; middle height, a lean frame. Light flaxen-brown long hair tied low at the nape in one tail, one loose lock falling over the corner of his left eye (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Clear blue eyes. Brass-framed goggles with hand-ground lenses always pushed up on his forehead. A black fingerless glove on his right hand; small old burn scars from the engraving stylus on the fingers of the left. No earrings, no other jewellery. A calm, absent-minded, faintly amused air; he answers with a number first.
face: FACE, as in the references: the same face and eye shape as the design references, a young man's face, clear blue eyes, a calm half smile with the lips closed.
build: 178 cm, lean and long-limbed, narrow shoulders of a workshop man, strong careful hands.
palette: deep blue, gold, white, brass, warm amber
casual: His workshop clothes, as in the design references: a white shirt with a high standing collar, the sleeves rolled once, under a long deep-blue waistcoat with gold edging and gold buttons that closes down the front, dark grey trousers and brown work boots; a heavy dark-brown leather apron with tool loops over it, a faint machine-oil smudge on one sleeve. The brass goggles pushed up on the forehead. He holds a small open clockwork heart of brass and glowing crystal in both hands, studying it.
private: At home after midnight: the waistcoat off, the white shirt open at the throat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long grey wool cardigan over it, dark trousers and soft house boots, the goggles still on the forehead. He holds a thin notebook open in one hand and a pencil in the other, about to write the day's single line.
battle: Working in the field: a short dark-blue coat with brass buttons over the white shirt, the leather apron belted tight, a satchel of tools across the chest, thick work gloves on both hands, the goggles pulled down over the eyes. He holds up a long brass engraving stylus whose rune-lit tip glows blue, ready to cut a command line into a machine's armour.
battle_pose: 3) the field-work outfit: standing braced with one foot forward, the goggles over the eyes, the glowing engraving stylus held up in the right hand, the left hand steadying an unseen machine plate, calm and focused, NOT holding any weapon.
formal: For the Arcane Society's hall: a long deep-blue frock coat with gold edging over the high-collared white shirt and the gold-buttoned waistcoat, a narrow dark cravat, dark trousers and polished boots, the brass goggles left pushed up on the forehead out of habit. He stands straight with a rolled set of drawings under one arm.
art: A close diagonal crop by the workshop lamp: warm amber lamplight from one side, deep blue shadow on the other; he holds a tiny glowing gear up between two fingers near his face, studying it with one eye half closed. Foreground blur: brass gears, the metal ear of a small clockwork hound, the rune-lit tip of an engraving stylus.

name: 维格贝特·海恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2119
who: Wigbert Hein, a human of an old wall-garrison family and the keeper of the wall town above the rain city, forty-five, at the very peak of mortal strength. Tall and massive, a thick back, a neck as thick as his head. Pale blond hair shaved close to the scalp, narrow ice-blue eyes that count everything. A forked, branching lightning scar across the back of his right hand (on the viewer's left when he faces us). His father's long blade, its spine inlaid with ancient dragon bone, never leaves him. He never sits down in front of others. A curt, numbers-first, iron-stubborn air; to him the war never ended. No jewellery.
face: FACE, as in the references: a hard, square face of about forty-five, faint lines at the eyes and between the brows, a heavy jaw, narrow ice-blue eyes under straight pale brows, a firm closed mouth, pale blond hair shaved almost to stubble.
build: About 190 cm, broad and massive: heavy shoulders, a thick chest and back, a thick neck, big forearms.
palette: deep red, steel grey, pale blond, ice blue, ivory bone
casual: His garrison dress: an old family mail hauberk to mid-thigh; over it a deep red sleeveless surcoat with the embrasure number embroidered on the chest as a plain white numeral 13; a broad leather belt, grey wool trousers and heavy hobnailed boots. In his right hand he holds his father's long blade upright at his side in a battered black scabbard; he stands squared, never at ease, a cold flat look.
private: Off duty in the garrison house, still standing: a coarse grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a dark brown leather waistcoat, grey wool trousers and the hobnailed boots. He holds a wooden tally stick in one hand and a small knife in the other, cutting count notches into it, a frown of concentration.
battle: Storming a gate: the mail hauberk under the deep red surcoat with the numeral 13, steel gauntlets, a grey-brown wool cloak thrown back over the shoulders. In both hands he raises his father's long blade, a long straight single-edged sword, NOT a curved sword, an ivory-grey strip of ancient dragon bone inlaid along its spine and a crackle of crimson lightning running down the edge; a cold, set face.
formal: At the wall roll-call: a long deep red wool coat that closes down the front with plain iron buttons, fitted sleeves, the numeral 13 embroidered in white at the left breast, the mail showing at the cuffs, black gloves, polished boots, the long blade sheathed at his left hip. He stands at attention, the hands clasped behind his back.
art: A tilted low-angle close portrait, the ice-blue eyes looking down at the viewer, flat and unblinking. Hard crimson light from one side glints on the dragon-bone spine of the blade he holds up across the frame. Foreground blur: crumbling stone dust from a gate arch, a few red lightning sparks, the rim of a grey wall stone.

name: 施特凡·策特尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2188
who: Stefan Zettel, a human clerk of the machine office who keeps the ledger of war machines melted down into ploughs, about fifty. Thin, his right shoulder (on the viewer's left when he faces us) higher than the left from decades bent over a desk. Ash-brown hair combed flat without one stray strand, pale hazel eyes that never meet yours, a pair of narrow-rimmed reading glasses. A small brass machine-office plaque at his belt. Ink-stained fingertips and beautiful handwriting. He never touches the machines, he dislikes their rust. A polite, precise, quietly greedy air; he answers everything with what the ledger says.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, clean-shaven face of about fifty, fine lines at the eyes and mouth, slightly hollow cheeks, a narrow nose, narrow-rimmed glasses, the eyes lowered, a polite tight-lipped mouth.
palette: dark grey wool, brass, ink black, ash brown, a little faded blue
casual: His office clothes: a dark grey wool long coat that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves covered from wrist to elbow by black cloth sleeve guards, a white shirt collar buttoned to the top, grey trousers and black shoes; the small brass machine-office plaque hangs on a short chain at his belt. He holds a thick leather-bound ledger open on one forearm and a pen in the other hand, a polite closed smile, the eyes on the page.
private: At home in the evening: a faded blue linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a brown knitted wool waistcoat, grey trousers and felt slippers, the glasses still on. He holds a clay mug of hot tea in both hands, a small satisfied look.
battle: On the road with a convoy of crates: the dark grey coat buttoned to the throat with the black sleeve guards, a grey wool travelling cloak over the shoulders, a flat grey felt hat, sturdy boots. He clutches the ledger shut against his chest; he never fights and holds no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: standing stiffly, the shoulders hunched, the ledger shut and clutched against his chest with both arms, the eyes sliding away; he never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: Before the court: a black wool coat that closes down the front with buttons to the throat, a white collar band, the black sleeve guards, the brass plaque at his belt, the ledger held under one arm. He stands with a small stiff bow, the polite closed smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face half turned down toward an open ledger, the eyes lifting over the narrow glasses toward the viewer without quite meeting them. Warm lamp light from one side glints on the glasses and the brass plaque. Foreground blur: a pen nib dripping ink, the corner of a ledger page with three neat lines of figures, a few flakes of rust.

name: 卢多尔夫
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2188
who: Rudolf, head of an old house on the north slope of the upper city, in his forties, at the peak of mortal strength. Tall, deep-chested, with very large, rough hands that hauled a bucket up a deep shaft alone at sixteen. Glossy black hair with a blue sheen cut very short, a few grey strands at the temples, blue-grey eyes, a short old scar across the chin. A plain iron ring on the little finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us). His house crest is a winch over a mine-shaft mouth. A quiet, courteous air that never raises its voice and is more frightening than shouting.
face: FACE, as in the references: a hard, handsome face in the mid-forties, faint lines at the eyes, a straight heavy brow, cool blue-grey eyes, a short pale scar across the chin, a closed, courteous mouth, very short black hair with grey at the temples.
build: About 188 cm, tall and heavy-chested: broad shoulders, thick forearms, very large rough hands.
palette: charcoal black, iron grey, slate blue, dull bronze, a little white
casual: His upper-city clothes: a long charcoal wool coat that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the house crest embroidered in dull bronze thread at the left breast, a small winch over a square mine-shaft mouth; a slate-blue waistcoat, a white shirt buttoned to the collar, dark trousers and heavy black boots. He holds a pair of black leather gloves in his right hand, the left hand bare with the iron ring, a calm, courteous look.
private: In his own house: a dark grey linen shirt open at the collar with the sleeves rolled up over thick forearms, a plain leather waistcoat, dark trousers and boots. He holds a heavy old iron key on a cord, weighing it in his palm, a quiet look.
battle: At the bottom of the shaft: a dark leather coat over a short mail shirt, a broad belt, heavy boots, a leather glove on the right hand only, the left hand bare with the iron ring. A heavy iron chain is wrapped twice around his right forearm and hangs from his fist, its links lighting up one by one in a dull bronze glow and lifting like a snake; a calm, cold face.
formal: Upper-city best: a long black wool coat that closes down the front with bronze buttons, fitted sleeves, a high collar trimmed with dark fur, the bronze winch crest at the left breast, a slate-blue waistcoat, a white neckcloth, black gloves, polished black boots. He stands very straight, the hands clasped in front, a polite closed smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, the blue-grey eyes looking straight at the viewer as if he has just said their name. Cold blue light falls from above as if down a shaft, a warm bronze glow rises from the chain in his fist below. Foreground blur: glowing chain links, the iron rim of a winch drum, drops of well water.

name: 斐里安
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2213
who: Ferian, a soft-spoken demon of a long-lived race; his name has set and he has stopped at the look of a fifteen- or sixteen-year-old, exactly as young as in the design references, a slender frame of middle height. Messy, flyaway ash-violet hair reaching the back of the neck, tied loosely with a faded old strip of cloth that still shows one blue stripe along its edge. Amber-gold eyes that glow faintly in the dark; he can see the flame of life inside every person. A gold-rimmed monocle over his right eye (on the viewer's left when he faces us). No other jewellery. A gentle, patient, unreadable air, older than his face.
face: FACE, as in the references: the same face and eye shape as the design references and just as young; calm amber-gold eyes, the gold-rimmed monocle over the right eye, a quiet closed mouth.
palette: ash violet, silver grey, black, amber gold, a little candle orange
casual: His everyday clothes, as in the design references: a black high-collared shirt with a neat black cravat, a long silver-grey coat edged in black that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, dark trousers and black boots, covered from the neck to the wrists. He holds an old leather-bound ledger of names under one arm, the other hand loose at his side, a calm, patient look.
private: By the gate-arch fire at night: the long coat off, a long-sleeved dark grey wool tunic buttoned to the collar, dark trousers and boots, a grey wool blanket around his shoulders. He holds a small piece of honey cake in one hand, a quiet, faintly guilty look.
battle: The silver-grey coat buttoned to the throat, a short dark grey wool cape over the shoulders, the cravat tucked in, black gloves. He holds no weapon: one hand raised before his face with two fingers lifted as if about to pinch out a flame, the amber-gold eyes glowing, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing still and upright, the feet slightly apart, one hand raised before his face with two fingers lifted as if about to pinch out a candle flame, the amber eyes glowing, the mouth closed; he holds no weapon.
formal: For a solemn occasion: a long black frock coat edged in silver grey that closes down the front with buttons to the throat, fitted sleeves, a white high collar and the black cravat, the old striped cloth strip still in his hair, black gloves. He stands straight with the hands clasped behind his back, a quiet, grave look.
art: A chest-up portrait with the camera tilted, the amber-gold eyes fully open and looking at the viewer, a gentle, serious, unreadable look, the mouth closed. Warm candle-gold light from one side, deep violet in the shadows. One slender hand raised near his face, two fingers lifted beside a small candle flame. Foreground blur: many tiny floating candle flames, the nearest guttering into a thread of smoke, the corner of an old leather ledger of names. Fully clothed to the neck.

name: 伊诺克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2213
who: Enoch, a small, quiet demon boy of a long-lived race who looks fourteen or fifteen, exactly as young as in the design references, a small slight frame wholly covered by his clothes. Short light-brown hair with a side part under a small round light-brown felt cap. Warm grey-brown eyes, solemn and a little wary. Old marks on both wrists that he always keeps hidden under his too-long sleeves, never shown. Fire cannot hurt him and he is always warm. He likes to stand half behind the one he calls teacher. A shy, earnest, faintly eerie air.
palette: purple, faded gold, lace white, ember orange, ash grey
casual: His clothes, as in the design references: a purple coat that closes down the front with buttons, embroidered with faded gold scrollwork, its sleeves too long and falling past the knuckles, the cuffs scorched into a dark ring; a white lace jabot at the throat pinned with a small blue stone; dark breeches, long dark stockings and buckled black shoes; the small round felt cap. Both hands half hidden in the long sleeves and held close in front, a solemn, wary look.
private: At home under the gate arch: a long-sleeved ivory wool shirt buttoned to the collar, a plain purple knitted waistcoat, dark trousers and soft boots, the felt cap, a grey wool blanket around his shoulders. He holds a folded scrap of paper with a prayer written on it, the sleeves over the wrists, a quiet look.
battle: The purple coat buttoned to the throat, the jabot tucked in, a short dark grey wool capelet. He holds no weapon: one too-long sleeve raised near his chin as he recites a prayer backwards, small embers and tongues of flame curling around his hands without burning him, the eyes open and wary, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing small and still, the feet together, one too-long sleeve raised near his chin as he recites, a few embers curling around his hands, the eyes open and wary, the mouth closed; he holds no weapon.
formal: For a rite: the purple coat freshly brushed under a short deep purple wool cape, a clean white lace jabot with the small blue stone, white gloves under the long sleeves, the felt cap. He stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a solemn, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the camera tilted, looking straight at the viewer, solemn and a little wary, the eyes fully open and the mouth closed, one hand half hidden in the long scorched sleeve held up near his chin. Ember-orange light from below and one side, purple in the shadows. Foreground blur: tongues of flame, drifting embers and grey ash. The collar and coat fully cover the shoulders and chest.
identity: ../../../立绘/原典参考_11-19/切_雅各布_伊诺克.png

name: 玛蓓
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2213
who: Mabel, called little Mabel by the folk of the gate arch, a human healer of the White Candle, a grown young woman exactly as young as in the design references, of middle height. Light flaxen-brown hair like her brother's, a thin braid at each temple wound back and pinned behind the head, under a small round navy cap. Blue-grey eyes, a dimple in her right cheek only (on the viewer's left when she faces us). Warm hands that stop bleeding with a touch. She brings flowers every day to a sick friend. A practical, cheerful, scolding-kind air; she treats everyone and picks no sides. No earrings, no jewellery.
palette: navy, candle white, flaxen brown, narrow gold, a little flower pink
casual: On duty: a White Candle healer's white wool robe edged with a narrow gold band, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves rolled to the elbow; over it a long white apron with a small white candle embroidered at one corner; the small round navy cap; plain brown boots. She holds a small bunch of slightly wilted wildflowers in one hand, the other hand reaching out palm up as if to say show me your hand, a warm, firm smile.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved navy wool dress to the ankles with a white collar, a grey-blue knitted shawl around the shoulders, the navy cap, brown boots. She holds a small cloth-covered basket of bread rolls on one arm, a cheerful smile.
battle: On the wall on a bad night: the white gold-edged robe under a navy wool cloak with the hood thrown back, the sleeves tied up with tapes, a leather satchel of bandages across the body. She holds no weapon: both hands held forward, a soft white healing light between the palms, a determined face.
battle_pose: 3) the field outfit: standing ready, the feet planted, both hands held forward palms down with a soft white healing light between them, a determined face; she holds no weapon.
formal: At a White Candle rite: a long white robe edged with narrow gold that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a navy stole embroidered with small white candles, the navy cap, the temple braids freshly pinned. She holds a lit white candle in both hands, a quiet, earnest smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, looking at the viewer with a warm, scolding smile that shows the dimple in her right cheek, holding a slightly wilted wildflower near her face. Soft warm candle light from one side, cool blue in the shadows. Foreground blur: the brass ear of a small clockwork hound at her shoulder, a drift of white candle smoke, falling petals.
identity: ../../../立绘/原典参考_11-19/切_玛丽安_玛蓓.png

name: 佩林
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2213
who: Perrin, a human man of the rain city who was the old gatekeeper's helper and carried the children of the gate arch on his back as they grew up, exactly as young as in the design references, of middle height and a lean frame. Hair colour, cut and eye colour exactly as in the design references. His lungs were ruined by smoke; he coughs every winter, a long wool scarf always wound round his throat. A smudge of grey ash on his left cheek (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A good-natured, forgetful air; he laughs at his own jokes before telling them and has always wanted to be a gatekeeper. No jewellery.
palette: ash grey, ember red, faded rust, undyed wool, a little soot black
casual: His everyday clothes: a grey-brown wall-issue wool coat too big for him, the sleeves rolled three times, buttoned crookedly over an undyed linen shirt; a long rust-red wool scarf wound twice round the neck; brown trousers and patched boots. He holds a small leather hand bellows, grinning as if about to laugh at his own joke.
private: Resting through a cold spell: a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic, a sheepskin vest worn fur inside, the rust-red scarf up to the chin, brown trousers and soft boots. He holds a clay cup of hot water in both hands, a sheepish grin.
battle: Keeping the gate at night: the grey-brown coat belted with a rope, a sand-coloured short cloak with white cloth strips sewn round the hood, the scarf, a small brass whistle on a cord at the chest. He holds no weapon, only a horn-shuttered lantern raised in one hand, the other arm flung out wide as if barring a doorway, a stubborn grin.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-watch outfit: standing broad and planted, one arm flung out wide as if barring a doorway, a horn-shuttered lantern raised in the other hand, a stubborn grin; he holds no weapon.
formal: The day he hoped to be sworn in as gatekeeper: a clean grey-brown wool coat buttoned straight for once with brass buttons, a white neckcloth, the brass whistle on a cord at the chest, the rust-red scarf neatly tied, polished boots. He stands very straight, trying hard not to laugh.
art: A tilted close portrait, grinning at the viewer as if about to laugh at his own joke, the smudge of ash on his cheek. Warm ember-red firelight from below and one side. Foreground blur: sparks from a freshly blown fire, drifting grey ash, the scorched nozzle of a hand bellows.

name: 玛丽贝尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2257
who: Maribel, a petite clockwork automaton who calls herself the clockwork princess; about twenty in looks by the household's reckoning but with a face exactly as young and doll-like as in the design references, and she never ages. Soft cool ash-grey-brown hair in loose soft curls cut to the chin, short straight blunt bangs, two long soft locks at the front. Clear blue eyes like polished magic crystals. Porcelain-white skin with hair-thin doll seams around both wrists and down the left side of her neck (on the viewer's right when she faces us). A brass wind-up key set in her back between the shoulder blades, its bow showing above her shoulder, turning slowly. A sharp-tongued, soft-hearted, deadpan air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a small round soft doll face with full cheeks and a small chin, very large round eyes with the upper lids just slightly drooping, a tiny nose and a small mouth, a short neck; no eyeliner, no heavy lashes, no eye shadow, no lipstick, no sharp adult features.
palette: obsidian black, deep crimson, red-gold, porcelain white, pale crystal blue
casual: The old-fashioned black-and-white gown her maker made for her: a white frilled lace headdress; a black choker with a small red-gold gear pendant; an obsidian-black bodice that closes down the front with red-gold gear buttons and small cut obsidian stones, over layers of deep crimson ruffles; long fitted black sleeves with white lace cuffs; a full ankle-length black skirt over white petticoats; black buttoned boots. She holds a porcelain teacup in both hands just below her chin, a blank, sleepy, deadpan face.
private: In the workshop: a long-sleeved white blouse buttoned high, a plain black pinafore dress to the ankles, a canvas work apron, black boots, the lace headdress off and a black ribbon in the hair. She holds a large brass spanner, an unimpressed look.
battle: The black-and-crimson gown with a fitted black half-cape over the shoulders, the lace headdress tied tight, black gloves on the left hand only. One bare right hand raised palm out with a faint glowing lotus pattern on the palm, small luminous squares lighting up one by one around her and frost-white light gathering at her fingertips; a flat, cold stare. She holds no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing upright and still, one hand raised palm out with a faint glowing lotus pattern on it, small luminous squares lighting up one by one around her, a flat deadpan stare, the mouth closed; she holds no weapon.
formal: A long gown of black satin with a high white lace collar, red-gold gear buttons down the front, a deep crimson ruffled underskirt, white lace gloves, a small black hat with a short lace veil pinned on the curls, the gear choker. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, the same blank, deadpan face.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre. She holds a porcelain teacup just below her chin and looks at the viewer with wide-open eyes and a blank, faintly sleepy, deadpan face; her other hand shows a faint glowing lotus pattern on the palm. Strong pale crystal-blue light from one side, deep crimson in the shadows. Foreground blur: red-gold gear teeth, the rim of a porcelain teacup, a turning clockwork wind-up key.

name: 法提赫·焦门
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2295
who: Fatih Scorchgate of the flame-horn clan, the door-ram of Grey Ridge, a demon whose name set before the ninety-ninth city gate he broke; he has looked a little under thirty for centuries. Tall and broad-shouldered. White hair shaved close to the scalp, amber-red eyes. A pair of horns, each ringed by a band of black obsidian, the tips scorched black. On the back of his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) ninety-nine small dot brands in neat rows, one place left empty. His sword Embergate, forged from gate nails, never leaves him. Slow, courteous and patient; he talks about everything as doors. No jewellery.
build: About 192 cm, tall and broad: wide shoulders, a deep chest, long heavy arms.
palette: black leather, obsidian, scorched iron, white, amber red
casual: His everyday clothes in the western camps: a black leather short coat with the cuffs closed by iron rings, a dark grey coarse wool tunic underneath, a wide belt, dark wool trousers and heavy hide boots, a sheepskin mantle thrown over the right shoulder. In his right hand he holds the sword Embergate in a scabbard studded with old iron nail heads, a polite, patient look.
private: At rest in Grey Ridge: a loose dark grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up to show the branded dots, a sheepskin vest worn fur inside, dark trousers and boots. He turns a single old iron gate nail between his fingers, a quiet, distant look.
battle: The door-ram at a crossing: a heavy black leather coat with iron-ringed cuffs over a shirt of blackened iron scales, hide bracers, heavy boots. He holds the sword Embergate in both hands: a long straight single-edged blade, NOT a curved sword, forged from old gate nails, the round nail heads still showing in rows along its dark iron flat with embers glowing between them; a calm, courteous stare.
formal: At the feast below the seat: a long black leather coat to the shins that closes down the front with iron rings, fitted sleeves, a dark red wool sash, a black wool mantle fastened at the chest with an iron door-ring, the obsidian bands on the horns polished. He stands very straight with both hands resting on the pommel of the sheathed sword planted before him.
art: A tilted close portrait, the amber-red eyes calm and courteous, the branded left hand raised near his face. Ember-red light from one side, cool grey river light on the other. Foreground blur: old iron gate nails falling like rain, river mist, a splinter of a gate's timber.

name: 艾克贝特·霍恩巴赫
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2363
who: Eckbert Hornbach, a human, second son of the border-army house that keeps the salt-road gate through the wall and forty miles of salt pans behind it; here about thirty-four. Middle height, about 175 cm, lean, the back held unusually straight. Pale flaxen hair combed straight back, cool grey-blue eyes, a short pale old scar across the bridge of the nose from a fall off a mule. A string of small brass salt-pan measuring rulers hangs at his right hip (on the viewer's left when he faces us); he always has a small worn leather notebook in which he counts people. Fair skin. No earrings, no rings, no glasses. Calm and unhurried, he never raises his voice and talks like a man taking inventory.
palette: salt white, grey-brown wool, brass, pale flaxen, sealing-wax red
casual: His everyday clothes on the gate road: a grey-brown wall-issue wool long coat, well brushed and buttoned to the chest, a small house crest of a gate tower stitched in brass thread on the left breast; beneath it a plain dark grey wool waistcoat and a white linen shirt, grey breeches and tall plain riding boots; the string of brass measuring rulers at his right hip. In his left hand the small leather notebook held open, in his right a pencil paused mid-count; he stands very straight, the face mild and unreadable.
private: At home on the salt estate in the evening: the coat off, a white linen shirt buttoned to the collar with the sleeves neatly folded to the forearm, the dark grey wool waistcoat, grey breeches and soft leather house shoes. He holds an open account ledger against one forearm and runs a finger down a column, the back still perfectly straight, the expression flat and attentive.
battle: Leading thirty gate soldiers to the well: an old riveted chain mail shirt under the grey-brown wall coat, a sand-coloured short cloak over one shoulder, leather gloves, a plain straight arming sword sheathed at his left hip and left untouched. A flat oak bottle case with a brass latch hangs open on a strap across his chest, rows of small vials inside; in his raised right hand he holds up one narrow-necked glass vial of dark red blood stoppered with red sealing wax pressed with a seal, his thumb resting on the wax. Calm and precise, not angry.
battle_pose: 3) the gate outfit: standing very straight and still, the feet set apart, one arm raised holding a small wax-sealed glass vial up at eye level like a piece of evidence, the other hand at his side, the sword left in its sheath; he does not fight with his hands, the vial is his weapon.
formal: Before the wall houses' council: a long dark grey-brown wool coat to the knee, closes down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, the gate-tower crest embroidered in brass thread on the breast, a white linen stock at the throat, a narrow leather belt with a rune-engraved spell-gun hung at the left hip as a mark of rank, slender and wand-like, NOT a firearm, polished boots and plain leather gloves. He stands with heels together and the notebook tucked under one arm, a polite, flat expression.
art: A tilted close portrait, his face large and off-centre, the grey-blue eyes looking just past the viewer as if counting heads, a mild closed-mouth expression. Harsh white salt-glare light floods in from one side, cold and bright, with a warm red glint of sealing wax at the edge. Foreground blur: rows of narrow-necked wax-sealed glass vials, white salt crystals, the edge of a brass measuring ruler. He wears the grey-brown wall coat with the brass-thread crest.

name: 妲蕾格·铁灰鳞
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2054
who: Dalreg Ironscale, a dragonkin woman of the iron-grey-scaled clan of a northern old keep, who has looked twenty-seven ever since her name set in the year 197. Very tall and powerful. Two short horns at the temples sweep backward; glossy blue-black hair with a deep blue sheen, braided at the nape; pale violet eyes with slit pupils. Thick iron-grey scales cover her forearms and shins, the gaps between them glinting faint frost blue; a thick iron-grey tail; dark claw-tipped fingers. A wide leather strap around her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us) hides a ring of bare white skin where the scales never grew back. Fair skin elsewhere. No earrings, no jewellery. A steady, plain, warm air; she would rather mend your boat than talk about herself.
build: 186 cm, tall and powerfully built: level square shoulders, a firm solid waist, a full E-cup bust and broad rounded hips, long strong legs and a thick dragon tail; she stands with her weight pressed onto the front foot.
palette: deep navy blue, iron grey, frost blue, blue-black, pale violet
casual: Her travelling clothes: a deep navy-blue wool long coat to the calf, slit at the back for the tail and at the sides for striding, closes down the front with iron buttons, fitted sleeves pushed to the elbow to bare the scaled forearms; under it a grey linen tunic with a broad leather belt, a wooden caulking mallet tucked into the belt, dark wool knee breeches with the scaled shins bare above low hide ankle boots. A heavy coil of tarred ferry rope hangs over her right shoulder (on the viewer's left when she faces us). She stands with her weight on the front foot, a calm, straightforward look.
private: A guest at a ferryman's house: the coat off, a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic with the sleeves pushed up, dark wool breeches, the scaled shins bare above soft felt shoes, the braid brought over one shoulder. She holds a small clay pot of honey out in both hands as if showing it to a child, the claw tips drawn back into her cuffs, an eager, gentle smile.
battle: Holding the ice on the frost river: the navy long coat buttoned tight under a grey wolf-fur short mantle, a thick iron ferry chain wound twice around her forearm and gripped hand over hand in both fists, braced to haul; frost-blue light leaks from between her scales, a thin pale breath of frost at her lips, NOT a cigarette. The feet wide, the weight on the front foot, the tail braced behind her, the jaw set.
formal: Called to a northern long hall: a long deep navy-blue wool coat to the ankle with a high collar, closes down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem and cuffs embroidered with a band of silver frost-knot patterns, a grey wolf-fur mantle pinned at one shoulder with a plain iron knot-shaped clasp, the braid neatly retied. She stands straight with the clawed hands folded in front, a patient, slightly awkward smile.
art: A tilted close portrait seen from slightly below, the face large and off-centre, the slit pale violet eyes looking at the viewer, steady and warm, the mouth closed. Cold blue-white light from cracked river ice rises from below and one side and glows in the gaps of her scales, with a single warm lantern glint at the far edge. Foreground blur: a taut tarred rope, broken ice shards and drifting snow. She wears the navy-blue coat, the horns catching the light.

name: 埃斐林·晨栎
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:2054
who: Efelin Morningoak, a high elf of the house of Morningoak, over six hundred and seventy years old, who has looked about twenty-seven ever since his name set in 238. Tall, 184 cm, narrow-shouldered with a very straight back, the arms solid from long years at the bow. Long gold-green hair tied loosely behind his shoulders with a plain copper clasp; deep blue eyes; long pointed elf ears, the tip of the left ear split by an old notch (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Fair skin. No earrings, no rings, no glasses. A warm, talkative, patient teacher's air, old grief kept well back; he remembers how every one of his comrades laughed.
palette: grey-green, gold-green, old copper, banner blue, a dusting of bright chalk colours
casual: His instructor's clothes: an old grey-green wool instructor's coat to the knee, closes down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, smudged all over with bright coloured chalk dust from children painting flags; a plain linen shirt and a dark green waistcoat beneath, grey-green trousers and tall brown boots kept perfectly clean. Under one arm he carries a folded old banner of faded blue cloth; a relaxed, kind half-smile.
private: At the students' long supper table: the coat off, a loose linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, the dark green waistcoat unbuttoned, grey-green trousers and the clean boots. He holds a strip of cloth in one hand and a needle in the other, unpicking a badly sewn stitch, smiling in the middle of a story.
battle: Calling the watch: a weathered grey-green field coat buttoned to the throat over an old elven scale shirt, leather bracers, a plain elven longbow slung across his back. With both hands he lifts a tall wooden banner pole high, the old torn and patched blue banner of a bow-and-tower company unfurled above him, wet and dripping, a faint blue glow along its edges. The mouth open in a call, the eyes steady, the feet planted.
formal: At the academy's instructors' assembly: a long grey-green wool coat to the ankle with a high collar, closes down the front with copper buttons, fitted sleeves, a small bow-and-tower device embroidered in faded blue on the left breast, a dark green sash, polished brown boots. He stands straight with his hands loosely clasped behind his back, a mild, amused smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the deep blue eyes looking up and out past the viewer, the lips parted as if reading a name aloud. Cool blue light pours in from one side as if through rain from a glowing banner, a warm copper glint in his gold-green hair. Foreground blur: falling rain in long blue curtains, the dripping edge of the old patched banner, a strip of cloth with careful hand stitching. He wears the grey-green instructor's coat smudged with chalk.
